title: Collection-path gate on a synthetic project
purpose: S1-A/S1-C-prep/S1-D/S1-B each changed a collection path that decides what ships or what the final audit consumes. G1 exercises all four on one synthetic tree so a regression is caught here rather than at canary time.

paths_gated.1_classification: current_dirty.classify_manifest_changes - per-path obligation asserted for 12 representative paths
paths_gated.2_final_input_manifest: finalization.build_final_input_manifest - canonical results present, and no S1-B-registered path was promoted into the closure
paths_gated.3_submission_bundle: submission_bundle.submission_bundle_paths - the bundle does not grow with the registered paths, and the two fail-closed gates still see an unknown authored artifact as uncovered
paths_gated.4_cleanup_protection: the policy-aware protected set still covers canonical results and still excludes data/intermediate

properties_asserted: the 21 registered paths are policy-only and none has a Stage owner
the fail-closed pair is gone for registered paths and intact for an unknown one
no registered path entered the final-input or submission closure
the classifier's obligation and the provenance attribution agree, path by path
opening the project read-only appends no event and moves no revision
note_on_assertion_style: the gate asserts properties rather than golden byte counts, so it keeps working as the tree grows; golden manifests would have to be regenerated on every legitimate change and would stop being read
